key_catalyst: Micron-led memory/semiconductor rally driving Nasdaq 100 above 29,000, absorbing the concurrent Rystad Saudi-oil-blockade warning
reasoning: The morning SELL rested on an escalating Iran/Hormuz oil shock layered on AI SECTOR_ROTATION, but the intraday window inverted that premise: the only live macro item was a CONDITIONAL Rystad warning ('2.5MM bpd at risk,' Houthis 'threaten to' blockade) rather than a fresh oil surge or actual new blockade, and the dominant live catalyst was chip-POSITIVE — Micron/WDC/Sandisk led a broad rebound and the Nasdaq 100 topped 29,000. QQQ closed +0.34%, so the market actively absorbed the geopolitical headline rather than extending it. What remains unresolved is the latent Saudi/Hormuz oil-supply tail that could re-price in the Asia/Europe overnight session, but nothing objectively escalated into the close.
